title: 126 The Sweepstakes, Ballsbridge Park, Dublin 4
description: **Available Immediately** **Furnished** Sherry FitzGerald Lettings presents this two double bedrooms, two bathroom apartment, extending to 118sqm of accommodation and decorated to the highest standard. Accommodation consists of entrance hallway with WC, fully fitted ugh end kitchen with fridge/freezer, dishwasher, microwave, oven and hob, open-plan living/dining room with fireplace and large south-facing balcony off, two large double bedrooms, both en-suite, main bathroom and walk in wardrobe. There is a large garage at ground level offering ample storage. Off-street parking for 2 cars.
